verdict.rationale: Termius docs say it can generate Ed25519, ECDSA, RSA and ML-DSA keys. It also manages SSH keys with passphrase protection in a Keychain that hosts can reference, and imports existing ~/.ssh key files. Together these clearly cover key-based SSH connection with all three key types. Community reports confirm everyday use as an SSH client. Missing for 10: docs that explicitly confirm authenticating (not just generating) with each key type, and independent hands-on corroboration of Ed25519/ECDSA/RSA key auth specifically.
